method: Actual local tools.view_image inspection at original resolution, all 12 panels displayed in three four-panel batches.

square.notes: Viewed all four square panels at original resolution. Main and repair labels, 1024x1024/seed/steps/quality and SSIM/PSNR are legible and outside source images. Blue teapot, cup, wooden table and window remain aligned within every pair, with no visible missing object, crop, blank output or repair-specific corruption. Long prompt yields darker cobalt blue in both columns; returned-lossless panel visually agrees. Visual agreement does not prove perfect compliance with every editing instruction.

wide.notes: Viewed all four wide panels at original resolution. Full 1792x512 images and all main/repair/configuration/metric labels are visible. Each pair retains the same blue teapot, lid, handle, background cup and table lighting; no repair-specific object, framing or gross visual change is apparent. The long-prompt output is a darker glossy cobalt in both columns; returned-lossless panel agrees. This does not assert pixel identity for high or perfect instruction following.

tall.notes: Viewed all four tall panels at original resolution. The complete 512x1792 outputs, source labels and metrics are visible. A small blue teapot and pale cup sit on the table below the window in both columns, with matching table legs, background and framing; no repair-specific missing object, blank region or gross corruption is apparent. Long-prompt teapot is darker cobalt in both columns; returned-lossless panel agrees. Tall remains quality/shape evidence, not primary performance evidence.

scope: Local visual inspection is separate from the numerical source/hash/quality audit and does not establish perfect semantic instruction following. High outputs are numerically close, not pixel-identical. Official b08c cleanup failure and PR counting remain unchanged.
